findings: Source preserves preorder/inorder to postorder only; node-value uniqueness, validity guarantees, scale, recursion policy and signature are not preserved.
The fixed candidate now contains a standalone compilable Java class while keeping unique integer values explicitly scoped as its executable contract rather than a source fact.
Preorder root selection, inorder partitioning and leftSize-based preorder slicing are mechanically consistent with direct left-right-root emission and require no intermediate tree allocation.
The hash index removes repeated inorder scans, supporting expected O(n) total time; recursion depth still reaches O(n) for a degenerate tree and is disclosed.
Duplicate value ambiguity and inconsistent traversals fail closed instead of being silently guessed.
The independent fixture matches direct conversion against generated postorder for all 2056 binary-tree shapes through eight nodes and covers malformed inputs; no hard failure remains.
